title: Ruff
author: Astral
failure: Unused imports, undefined names, and other concrete Python errors that polished code can hide.
when: Run on every Python change. Start with correctness rules before adding style preferences.

title: TypeScript: strict mode
author: Microsoft
failure: Implicit any types and unchecked null values that defer failures until runtime.
when: Enable in your own trusted project, install its real dependencies, and review diagnostics rather than suppressing them.

title: Mutation testing with Stryker
author: Stryker Mutator contributors
failure: Tests that pass while meaningful production behavior is broken.
when: Use in your own trusted checkout after ordinary tests pass; inspect surviving mutations in critical paths.

title: Code review: what to look for
author: Google Engineering Practices
failure: Changes that compile but introduce unnecessary complexity, weak tests, or misleading names.
when: Use as a human review checklist for both AI-assisted and manually written changes.
